## 3. Core Enterprise Operating Framework
1. **Disciplined Scaling (+15% to +20%)**: Budget increases occur only when conversion volumes stabilize statistically every 48-72h to avoid resetting machine learning algorithms.
2. **Stop-Loss Rule (1.5x CPA)**: Zero emotional attachment to creative sets; ad sets exceeding 1.5x target CPA without conversions are sunset immediately.
3. **Weekly Creative Velocity**: 3 fresh hook variants deployed weekly based on 3-second retention drops before ad fatigue degrades blended CPA.
4. **Data Ownership & NDA**: 100% bilateral NDA compliance; all telemetry, pixels, customer lists, and accounts remain under full client ownership.
